pages.transcription:
c/o Viking Press
18 East 48th St

New York, 13.7.40.

Dear Hanna,
I hope that we will hear
from you by clipper while we are still
here, and there is even a remote possi-
bility that we might not take the boat
on the 26th but the one after it as we
would like to await the replies from
Brazil and the other countries.
You will have got a cable
from Rabbi Stephen Wise to your Lon-
don address giving an affidavit for
Eva, which as I am told, is now ne-
cessary, in order to get children over.
Stefan and I went to see him in quite
different matters and we just mentioned
that we wanted to bring over our niece.
He immediately said he would see to it
and give the necessary guarantee and
the committee where his wife or daughter
is one of the leading people would
see to it that she comes into a nice fa-
mily. In these twenty minutes - he is
a big person and it was more or less
like an extremely friendly audience -
I suppose you have heard from him.

[Randnotiz links, von unten nach oben geschrieben:]
Dear Hannah, warmest regards. I have not yet the replies from Brazil
and quite about my lectures and perhaps we have to wait for another
ship. Meanwhile I write here and prepare the lectures and I work at all

[Randnotiz rechts, von oben nach unten geschrieben:]
'Bote'
I hope as we expected. Hope Manfred, the children all well
and I have done all I could for Edemann and hope good results. Lotte
pages.notes: Handschriftlicher Brief auf Briefpapier. Die Randnotizen sind in einer anderen Ausrichtung geschrieben. Die Tinte ist violett.

pages.transcription:
there was no chance to talk more
about it and ask questions. But
for the moment it seems to me the
most important to have the necessary
documents and to be able to send Eva
over. My sister-in-law and Rose (on whom
I rely more) have promised to look after
her, I am promised addresses of schools
and boarding-schools and am looking
round and asking all the people who
might know something. Rose is doing the
same, she and her brother-in-law have
guaranteed Elsie's and Carmel's children
and she does not yet know what to do
with them. The most important thing for
the moment is: do you want to send her
at the present moment, can you send
her with someone and when would she
come? I suppose you will let us know while
we are still here and I'll see to it that
she will be met at the boat by some
nice and reliable person I know.
I hope you are all well. Please
write as often as possible, if only a post-
card so that we are not without news.
Kindest regards to you, the children
and all the others,
Lotte.

pages.notes: Farbskala und Grauskala für Archivierungszwecke. Darunter ist ein Teil des Brieftextes von Seite 2 durch das Papier hindurch sichtbar.
